messages:
yasmin (evals): FYI we see a reproducible quality regression after exporting fujin-v1 -> q7 (aggressive token-minify + digit anchoring). Mixed Chinese+Arabic subtitle slice BLEU -4.7, chrF -0.09. :thinking_face:

leticia (eng-ml): is this limited to q7 or do other quant flavors show it?

yasmin (evals): FP16 baseline looks fine. q5 earlier passes were okay for this model; regression shows up only after q7 export.

omar (quant): q7 pipeline used token-minify=true, nfkc=true, anchor_digits=always, plus fold_layernorm. I suspect token-minify interacting with nfkc canonicalization.

yasmin (evals): small repro snippet (src -> ref -> fp16 -> q7):
```
src: "\u7b2c\u5341\u4e00\u7ae0 - \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 11: \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644"
ref: "\u7b2c\u5341\u4e00\u7ae0 - \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 11: \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644"
fujin-v1-fp16: "\u7b2c\u5341\u4e00\u7ae0 - \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 11: \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644"
fujin-v1-q7: "\u7b2c\u5341\u4e00\u7ae0 \u200e- \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 11: \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644"
```

yasmin (evals): Note the LTR mark (\u200e) inserted before the hyphen and a space shifted inside the CJK cluster in q7 output.

igor (serving): runtime canary logs show `kvcache: off_by=4 seq=14` for the failing request id and `decoder: saw_delim id=0` once. Might be token->kv offset mismatch.

sophie (infra): export job shows: `EXPORT fujin-v1 -> q7 (minify_tok=true, nfkc=true, anchor_digits=always, fold_ln=true) OK` at 3234567920. No pipeline errors. Canary started briefly; I'll pause rollout if needed.

omar (quant): can we get a tokenization dump? I want to see whether normalization inserted any invisible marks or changed token boundaries.

yasmin (evals): token dumps below (fp16 vs q7):
```
# fujin-v1-fp16 tokens: ['\u7b2c','\u5341','\u4e00','\u7ae0',' ','-',' ','\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645',' ','11',':',' ','\u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644']
# fujin-v1-q7 tokens: ['\u7b2c','\u5341','\u4e00','\u7ae0',' ','\u200e','-',' ','\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645',' ','11',':',' ','\u0627\u0644\u062a\u0633\u062c\u064a\u0644']
```

omar (quant): that inserted \u200e between CJK cluster and hyphen is suspicious. anchor_digits should only add markers around digit spans; looks like nfkc reordering produced a codepoint sequence that triggered the anchor heuristic.

igor (serving): We also saw `decoder: token_id_zero_emitted at seq=5` in the same request. That aligns with a missing grapheme in output. Adding extra token_id->kv_offset logs now for canary traffic.

sophie (infra): I'll pause q7 rollout in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 and route to fp16. Pausing at 3234567935.

leticia (eng-ml): mitigation: keep fp16 as default until we have a fix. Omar, can you bisect the export transforms? Try: 1) minify only 2) nfkc only 3) anchor_digits only 4) fold_ln only.

omar (quant): yep. I'll run a local bisect script `tools/export_bisect.py --model fujin-v1 --cases minify,nfkc,anchor,fold` and diff token ids + kv offsets. ETA ~2h. If anchor_digits triggers the insert, we can hotfix by disabling anchor for mixed-script heuristics.

yasmin (evals): I'll prepare a targeted subtitle eval subset (CJK chapter markers + Arabic inline) and run metrics for each bisect variant.

comms-bot: notify: partner-team notified that q7 rollout is paused for fujin-v1 in affected regions; fp16 remains default.

leticia (eng-ml): thanks. summary: regression on fujin-v1-q7 inserting LTR mark and shifting token boundary on mixed CJK+Arabic inputs; kv cache offset mismatches observed; q7 paused in two regions. Action items: export bisect (omar), focused eval subset (yasmin), extra token<->kv logging (igor). We'll reconvene after bisect results. :thumbsup:
